newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline sinks with NYMEX futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline sinks with NYMEX futures.

text.p: NWE gasoline was weaker on Thursday as NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures headed lower, traders said.

Eurograde barges traded at $205 fob ARA for February and $206 for the first days of March while regular barrels were heard to have been traded at $199. Cargoes were thin, and pockets of buying interest were seen into Hamburg and into the Thames.
But the late fall in futures prices made it hard to pin prices to cargoes.
